verdict.summary: The agent's claim about `syncColumns` is correct, but GOAL.md asks for a Phoenix todo app and this folder holds something else. I can't tell whether the goal is stale or the work is off-target.

criteria.criterion: Last request: `syncColumns` in src/sync.ts follows Orca's status names
criteria.evidence: src/sync.ts:24 builds `names` from `statuses` when the list is non-empty. Line 27 sets `title: names?.get(c.id) ?? c.title`, so existing columns take Orca's titles. Line 34 adds missing columns from Orca's list with Orca's titles. Statuses that are in use but absent from Orca's list get their id as the title (line 35). Nothing needed fixing, as the agent said.
